defects.defect: capability_name() instead of str(int(caps)) on the Capability Flag
defects.note: the site is in measure/, not access/. `Capability` is a Flag with no `__int__`, so `str(int(caps))` raises; from 3.11 a composite Flag always has a truthy `.name`, so the `or` never evaluates it. 4.0 requires >=3.11, which is why the branch is dead here and the CI failure was the 3.10 leg. The release helper is still worth taking and is proposed to P-PORT-2.

defects.defect: the reachability inventory test that asserted the developer's HF cache now pytest.skips
defects.note: `skip_without_extras` skips the reachability test when the extra is absent instead of asserting against a cached model.

the site is outside every slice of the release diff (it is a test file) and outside P-PORT's writable paths. The replacement assertion is written out in the handoff; the packet that owns tests/acceptance/ applies it. P-PORT carries nothing here: the row hands the work over and the wave-1 exit refuses it until that packet closes it.
